sources.snippet: We cannot guarantee that every faucet contains a good-quality ceramic cartridge. If customer service cannot identify the cartridge consider another faucet. Five-year warranty on cartridge is not nearly adequate. Pure importer and marketeer not a manufacturer sourcing from three to four identified Chinese factories.
sources.classification_reason: Pool S authority with explicit cartridge transparency and warranty warnings.

sources.snippet: Independent teardown identified multiple cartridge suppliers across catalog: Kerox (Hungary world-class) Sedal (Spanish-designed Chinese factories) Kuching International (China) Hain-Yo (Taiwan OEM). Two-handle models use Flühs (Germany) or Guangdong Hent Technology (China). Kraus does not disclose which cartridge is in which faucet model.
sources.classification_reason: Pool S teardown data revealing inconsistent cartridge sourcing across catalog.

sources.snippet: Cartridge warranty 5 years only — significantly below lifetime warranty from Moen Delta Grohe and others. Spray assemblies and hoses 1 year only. Handles and base plates carry NO warranty at all. Parts availability guaranteed 5 years only — long-term serviceability risk. Limited lifetime headline warranty is misleading given component exclusions.
sources.classification_reason: Warranty structure is the most significant professional objection — component exclusions gut the headline warranty.

sources.snippet: Kitchen faucets generally constructed of solid brass body confirmed across spec sheets. Lead-free brass compliant with federal and state requirements. Not independently teardown-verified beyond StarCraft examination. Weight and construction quality described as above-average for Chinese-origin product.
sources.classification_reason: Body material specification — claimed brass, generally confirmed.

sources.snippet: Kraus USA is a pure importer and marketeer not a manufacturer. Sources from three to four identified Chinese factories depending on product line. Does not design engineer or manufacture. Has no physical factory. Faucets sit in above-average to good tier of Chinese-origin product — meaningfully better than commodity Amazon flooding but below domestic or premium European.
sources.classification_reason: Pool S business model classification — marketeer with no manufacturing accountability.

sources.snippet: UPC cUPC certified confirmed through IAPMO listing. NSF/ANSI 61 and NSF 372 certified. ASME A112.18.1 compliant. Legally installable in US and Canada. Passes certification gate — this is not contraband product.
sources.classification_reason: Certification gate check confirmed — legal product.

sources.snippet: Cartridges user-replaceable with basic tools. Third-party Kerox K-35 replacement retails approximately $29.95. Hain-Yo cartridges available from aftermarket supply. However Kraus guarantees parts availability for 5 years only — after that no guarantee of replacement parts. Marketeer has no manufacturing control over component supply chain.
sources.classification_reason: Parts availability with 5-year limitation is significant long-term risk.

sources.snippet: Chrome and stainless steel look finishes standard. Spot-free stainless steel finish available on some models — marketed as fingerprint-resistant. No PVD finish technology.
sources.classification_reason: Finish specification — no PVD, limited options.

sources.snippet: Mixed professional opinion. Some plumbers consider Kraus functional and acceptable for budget applications. Others flag long-term reliability concerns and parts availability risk. Generally positioned as step above Amazon commodity but step below established brands.
sources.classification_reason: Professional forum consensus — mixed but consistent with mid-low positioning.

sources.snippet: Sourcing from 3-4 Chinese factories. Specific factory names and locations not disclosed by Kraus. Port Washington NY headquarters is office only — no manufacturing facility.
sources.classification_reason: Pool S finding on source traceability — unknown factories.

bottom_line: Marketeer model — does not manufacture. Claims solid brass but unknown cartridge supplier (mixed/generic Chinese). Chrome-only finish. Source traceability unknown. Limited parts availability. StarCraft rates low. Plumbers and pros warn about Kingston Brass/Kraus tier — premium-looking but ZAMAK/plastic inside. Lifetime warranty on paper but execution questioned.
